name: AI app builder for popular CMSs

mentions.name: AI app builder for popular CMSs
mentions.description: An AI-powered app builder (like Lovable) that generates websites and customizations for popular CMSs such as WordPress, Ghost, and Substack, translating users' ideas into working CMS implementations instead of producing code incompatible with their existing platform.
mentions.problem: News organizations can't take advantage of AI app builders like Lovable because the resulting code won't work with the CMS their staff is used to.
mentions.audience: News organizations looking to improve their online presence; their non-technical staff who work in CMSs like WordPress rather than writing code.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on creating Lovable for popular CMSs like wordpress, ghost, substack etc.
